title: 받침 읽기: 옷, 낮, 밭은 왜 같은 소리일까?
objective: Read a 받침 and say which of the seven sounds it makes.
summary: Many final letters make only seven final sounds.

task.title: Read the final sounds
task.line: Say each word out loud, then write or choose the sound you hear at the end.

letters.as: Like k in 'back', but stop it short with no puff of air.
Like t in 'hot', but hold your tongue still and don't let air out.
Like p in 'cup', but keep your lips closed at the end.

letters.sound: Sound as written — 산 [산], 물 [물], 밤 [밤], 방 [방]
letters.as: n, l, m, and ng as in 'sing'.

exercises: Write the real sound in [ ]: ① 맛 ② 겉 ③ 옆
Do the two words sound the same? Write Same or Different: ① 빗 – 빛 ② 입 – 잎 ③ 반 – 밤
Which final sound do you hear? Write [ㄱ], [ㄷ] or [ㅂ]: ① 무릎 ② 젖 ③ 약
Find the word whose final sound is different: ① 몇 / 붓 / 밥 ② 컵 / 잎 / 산 ③ 국 / 책 / 팥
answers: ① Same ([빋]) ② Same ([입]) ③ Different ([반] / [밤])
① 밥 ([ㅂ]; the others are [ㄷ]) ② 산 ([ㄴ]; the others are [ㅂ]) ③ 팥 ([ㄷ]; the others are [ㄱ])
